note: Some batch numbers move UP. Batch simulate used to set the nozzle exit diameter aside for every candidate while the Launch button used it, so the same motor gave two different answers in two places; each candidate now flies its own published exit where the app holds one, and the rows that did are marked. The staged-ignition default is now about propellant rather than power class - a booster ejection charge lights black powder and cannot light a composite, whatever size either is - so composite upper-stage motors default to electronics-timed, and an unrecorded propellant is assumed to need an igniter. A .CDX1 export now carries the nozzle exit diameter instead of writing zero, so a round trip through RASAero keeps it. On a phone the notice bar no longer covers the tab bar and swallows taps - the rule meant to lift it had never worked in 61 releases. In Daylight mode selected motor filters are visible again, and so is the drag-to-zoom box on the plots. The chart wheel zoom is normalised per click and shows a percentage. New camera shrouds are flat at the back. The motor catalogue is refreshed to 19 September. And the user guide is rewritten: it no longer claims a bit-for-bit match with desktop OpenRocket, which was not true and is not what the app does by default.
